summary: Iteration 28 — verified the three new features (active liveness, auto-timeout, missed-selfie flag) end-to-end against the deployed backend, plus regressed iter27 selfie retry and the face_match suite. New pytest module tests/test_active_liveness_iter28.py has 11 HTTP-level tests + 1 direct analyze_frames sanity test — all pass. Existing tests/test_active_liveness_unit.py (10) also pass. Regression: tests/test_selfie_retry_iter27.py (6) + tests/test_face_match.py (11) all pass. UI: admin dashboard live roster correctly renders the red 'IGNORED SELFIE CALL' badge with data-testid live-missed-selfie-{sid} after driving the auto-timeout flow.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/sessions.py — respond_challenge order is match-first, then active-liveness. This is a deliberate contract (user note confirms). Consider documenting that a mismatched liveness_frame won't be checked for liveness because the mismatch on the primary photo short-circuits — otherwise fine.

The 400 'Liveness check required' is raised BEFORE save_session_photo is called (good — no I/O), but AFTER save_session_photo runs earlier in the same handler. Actually: save_session_photo runs at line 569 BEFORE the liveness contract check at 583, so a client that omits liveness fields still pays the photo-store cost. Minor perf nit — consider moving the contract check above save_session_photo so an incomplete request short-circuits immediately.

_register_selfie_failure stores photo_saved=True on every failure attempt but the neutral/liveness frames aren't stored, only face_photo. If a security auditor wants to inspect what a failing user submitted (the liveness_frame), it's not persisted. Consider storing the liveness_frame too under a distinct key when a failure is recorded.
MAX_SELFIE_ATTEMPTS is still hard-coded — same feedback from iter27 stands: promote to an org setting.

timeout_challenge sets flagged=True unconditionally when a challenge expires, but the tick already sets flagged=True. Idempotency test passes, but if the challenge is already terminal via tick and the mobile then calls timeout, the redundant $set is fine — just noting the double-flag write for future refactors.
